summary: Tested Integration Hub (Event Bus) for iteration 112. All 20 backend tests passed. Key features verified: Integration Hub health endpoint returns correct metrics (total_events, success_rate, failed, pending, retry_queue, system_stats, recent_errors), data-model endpoint returns 16 entities with owner/relationships/sync_rules, events endpoint supports pagination and filtering by status/source, Deal Won → Order flow works correctly (opportunity closed_won triggers deal_closed_won event and creates sales order with SO-xxx number), event retry returns 404 for non-existent and 400 for completed events, Sage 200 config GET works (POST requires admin role), Sicon config GET works (uses service portal auth), all existing CRM endpoints still work (companies, contacts, opportunities, quotes, activities, dashboard, stages).

feature_1_integration_hub_health.details: GET /api/crm/integration-hub/health returns total_events, success_rate, failed, pending, retry_queue, system_stats, recent_errors, completed

feature_2_integration_hub_data_model.details: GET /api/crm/integration-hub/data-model returns 16 entities (company, site, contact, opportunity, quote, order, contract, asset, service_case, engineer_visit, invoice, payment, user, activity, document, ai_output) with owner, relationships, sync_rules

feature_3_integration_hub_events_list.details: GET /api/crm/integration-hub/events returns paginated event list with events array and total count

feature_6_deal_closed_won_creates_order.details: PUT /api/crm/v2/opportunities/{id} with stage=closed_won triggers deal_closed_won event (source=crm, target=finance, status=completed) and creates sales order

feature_7_sales_order_correct_fields.details: Sales order has order_number starting with SO-, opportunity_id linked, value set, status=pending_sync. Opportunity updated with order_id and order_number references.

feature_9_event_retry_completed_fails.details: POST /api/crm/integration-hub/events/{id}/retry returns 400 for completed events (only failed/retry events can be retried)

feature_11_sage200_config_post_admin_onl.details: POST /api/crm/sage200/config requires admin role (returns 403 for manager role)

feature_12_sicon_config_get.details: GET /api/sicon/config returns config structure (uses service portal auth, not CRM auth)

feature_19_crm_stages_regression.details: GET /api/crm/v2/opportunities/stages returns all 9 stages including closed_won

feature_20_health_counts_update.details: Integration health endpoint shows updated counts after events are created (total_events increases, success_rate calculated correctly)
